findings.summary: The ERS includes the aggregate SRAM cap but omits the binding conditional category ceilings, reserve, attribution/lifetime, nesting, dynamic allocation, and infeasibility obligations in CON-AP2-003-v6 and DE-AP2-RESOURCE-v7.
